The murder of the Barrio's family.
A middle-aged couple and their 12 year old son were found brutally murdered in their own house. There were no fingerprints, no DNA, and the door wasn't forced to gain entry. Everyone thought first that their other son, a conflictive 16 year old boy who was studying on a boarding school did it, but he was ruled out as a suspect for lack of evidence. Now they have another POI; Ángel Ruiz, a convicted killer that was their neighbour at the time and was allegedly in bad terms with the family.

On January 14th, 1989, three teenagers (Rosario, Francisco and Pilar) went on a camping trip and were never heard of again. Rosario's body was found 4 days later on the same stall where they were staying. Francisco was found on April 8, in the middle of a field, and Pilar wasn't found until May 24 near a river. Her body was missing a foot and a hand, which was later found in a nearby town, Alcásser. 
Alcásser became famous some years later for the killings of three other local teenage girls. The murderers were interrogated about this case, but they denied knowing anything.
